{{Season|Winter}} |weather = Any |difficulty = 50 |behavior = Sinker |size = 10-34 |price = 80 |edibility = 10 |roe = Light Gray }} The '''Halibut''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Winter]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|80}}. Halibut can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Halibut can be found in the ocean. {{Map|275|200}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== Halibut is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Halibut can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] ==Fish Pond== Halibut can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is light gray Halibut [[Roe]].
